items.title: Rewrite the serve-mode explanation in CLAUDE.md to match the real lattice serve surface
items.context: The existing text mentions web/cli variants that are not present in lattice serve --help. Update the prose so it only describes the supported serve options and does not imply extra modes that the CLI does not expose.

happy.desc: Run lattice check after the doc edit and confirm the framework audit no longer reports lattice serve --web or lattice serve --cli under CLAUDE.md#三种运行模式.

edge.desc: The rewritten prose still mentions the supported lattice serve --dev and --port surface without reintroducing phantom modes.

adversarial.desc: Search the edited onboarding copy and source comment for --web and --cli and confirm the stale serve-mode wording only exists in the known historical places before the fix.

items.userSees: CLAUDE.md now shows only supported lattice serve guidance: the serve-mode section uses lattice serve and lattice serve --dev="..."; the old --web / --cli examples are gone.

items.title: Rewrite the startup command block in CLAUDE.md so it only uses supported lattice serve flags
items.context: The current examples reference npm run serve, npm run serve:web, and npm run serve:cli, but those scripts are not defined and the serve entrypoint only advertises --dev and --port. Replace the examples with the actual supported invocation pattern.

happy.desc: The startup command block shows only supported lattice serve invocations and no npm run serve:web or npm run serve:cli examples.

edge.desc: Any remaining direct web startup example stays clearly separated from lattice serve so it cannot be misread as an unsupported CLI alias.

adversarial.desc: package.json and packages/main/package.json still do not contain serve:web or serve:cli scripts after the rewrite, so the docs cannot drift back to nonexistent npm commands.

items.userSees: CLAUDE.md now shows a single truthful startup command block: no npm run serve:web or npm run serve:cli, only supported lattice serve invocations.
